**Spec:** sections of `docs/language-spec-v0.md`, decisions of `docs/decisions.md` or open
questions (Q-n) this RFC is about.

## The question

What should be decided, in one or two sentences.

## What the spec says today

The current rule, quoted or summarized, with a short example in the text format (a complete
program can go in `docs/rfc/`, where it is checked and drawn).


## Questions

What you would like readers to answer: their practice, their preference, a case the options miss.
